correctness.rationale: The equality statement follows from strict discrete concavity and the fixed sum of cyclic window counts; an explicit periodic floor-difference construction attains the balanced bound. The exact-integer standalone verifier exhausts n<=12 for all widths and n<=18 for width three, and is corroborative rather than an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Optimal-set counting under PAV is broadly hard and important for tie-breaking. In a natural maximally symmetric circular-local approval family, the result determines every winning committee and its common exact score for every strictly concave Thiele rule, plus a closed-form number of ties at width three. At twelve candidates and six seats, 174 co-optimal committees demonstrate meaningful multiwinner ambiguity, and the family with n=6m and k=3m has at least 3 times binomial(2m,m) squared co-optima, growing exponentially; this is not an arbitrary single-profile calculation.
